case.summary: Customer C08299 reported not authorizing a $30.02 online charge on card C08299-K1 (transaction 3581141, December 28, 2016). The fraud-detection model scored it at 0.83 calibrated probability, consistent with card-not-present fraud. Investigation confirms fraud. Per Policy R2, the card is blocked and an internal case created. No SAR filing required (exposure $30.02 remains below the $1,000 threshold and no shared device or connected-card fraud).
